youtube_description:
Jesus... I'm the strong one for everyone, and I'm so tired. 😭 Bible verse for when you're tired of being strong.

Her: Jesus... I'm the strong one for everyone, and I'm so tired. 😭

Her: Tonight I cried in the bathroom so nobody would hear.

Jesus: I heard you in that bathroom. You don't have to be quiet with Me.

Her: If I fall apart, who holds everyone else together?

Jesus: You were never meant to hold everyone together. Strong people get carried too.

"Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken."
Psalm 55:22 (BSB)
